verses.sloka: ततः प्रहृष्टो हनुमान् कृत्यवान् इति तत् वचः ।श्रुत्वा मधुर भावम् च सुग्रीवम् मनसा गतः ॥४-४-१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭo hanumān kṛtyavān iti tat vacaḥ ।śrutvā madhura bhāvam ca sugrīvam manasā gataḥ ॥4-4-1॥

translations.english: After listening to the sweet words of Lakshmana, Hanuman, having done what he had to do felt happy and thought of Sugriva.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर सुग्रीतर प्रसन्न हो कर पुनः श्रीरामचन्द्रजी से बोले कि, हे रामचन्द्र ! मंत्रियों में श्रेष्ठ मेरे मंत्री हनुमान ने आपका सब वृत्तान्त मुझे बतला दिआ है

verses.sloka: भाव्यो राज्यागमः तस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ।यत् अयम् कृत्यवान् प्राप्तः कृत्यम् च एतत् उपागतम् ॥४-४-२॥
verses.transliteration: bhāvyo rājyāgamaḥ tasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ।yat ayam kṛtyavān prāptaḥ kṛtyam ca etat upāgatam ॥4-4-2॥

translations.english: The great Sugriva, thinks Hanuman, who had done his duty is likely to acquire his kingdom, because great Rama who would help in the work of Sugriva has also come.'
translations.hindi: हनुमान जी ने मुके सारा वृत्तान्त बतला दिआ है कि, जिस कारण आपको अपने छोटे भाई लक्ष्मण सहित वन में वास करना पड़ता है

verses.sloka: ततः परम संहृष्टः हनुमान् प्लवगोत्तमः ।प्रति उवाच ततो वाक्यम् रामम् वाक्य विशारदः ॥४-४-३॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ parama saṁhṛṣṭaḥ hanumān plavagottamaḥ ।prati uvāca tato vākyam rāmam vākya viśāradaḥ ॥4-4-3॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the best of the monkeys, learned in conversation, felt extremely happy and enquired from Rama:
translations.hindi: रुदन करती हुई आपकी भार्या मिथिलेशनन्दनी जानकी को राक्षस हर कर ले गया, जिस समय आप ओर धीमान्‌ लक्ष्मण उपस्थित न थे

verses.sloka: किम् अर्थम् त्वम् वनम् घोरम् पम्पा कानन मण्डितम् ।आगतः सानुजो दुर्गम् नाना व्याल मृग आयुतम् ॥४-४-४॥
verses.transliteration: kim artham tvam vanam ghoram pampā kānana maṇḍitam ।āgataḥ sānujo durgam nānā vyāla mṛga āyutam ॥4-4-4॥

translations.english: 'Why have you come with your brother to this dreadful, inaccessible forest surrounding Pampa, full of different varieties of serpents and wild animals?'
translations.hindi: वह राक्षरू तो अवसर की खोज में था ही (सो आप दोनों के दाभ्रम से हटते ही वह सीता को हर कर ले गयां ) जब जटायु ने ten she पष्ठः संग: ६३ उसे रोकना चाहा तब उस ( राक्षस ने ) जटायु को मार डाला। अब्र में थोड़े ही दिनों में आपके इस भार्या-बियोग-जन्य दुःख को दूर कर दूँगा

verses.sloka: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणो राम चोदितः ।आचचक्षे महात्मानम् रामम् दशरथात्मजम् ॥४-४-५॥
verses.transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā lakṣmaṇo rāma coditaḥ ।ācacakṣe mahātmānam rāmam daśarathātmajam ॥4-4-5॥

translations.english: Having listened to Hanuman, and urged by Rama, Lakshmana told him about the great Rama, son of Dasaratha.

verses.sloka: राजा दशरथो नाम द्युतिमान् धर्म वत्सलः ।चातुर् वर्ण्यम् स्व धर्मेण नित्यम् एव अभिपालयन् ॥४-४-६॥
verses.transliteration: rājā daśaratho nāma dyutimān dharma vatsalaḥ ।cātur varṇyam sva dharmeṇa nityam eva abhipālayan ॥4-4-6॥

translations.english: There was a brilliant king named Dasaratha, a lover of dharma, who ever ruled the four classes righteously according to their own duties.
translations.hindi: जिसे सेने क्ररकमा राक्षस द्वारा हर कर लिए जाते हुए देखा है । उस समय वह रास राम सोर लक्ष्मण लक्ष्मण कह कर उच्च स्वर से पुकार ही थी

verses.sloka: न द्वेष्टा विद्यते तस्य स तु द्वेष्टि न कंचन ।स तु सर्वेषु भूतेषु पितामह इव अपरः ॥४-४-७॥
verses.transliteration: na dveṣṭā vidyate tasya sa tu dveṣṭi na kaṁcana ।sa tu sarveṣu bhūteṣu pitāmaha iva aparaḥ ॥4-4-7॥

translations.english: 'He never hated any one nor did any one ever hate him. To all his subjects, he was like another father, the Creator Brahma. And he was generous in giving gifts while performing yajnas (rituals with fire) like Agnistoma.
translations.hindi: इन्द्रसहित देवता अथवा दैत्य दानव कोई भी आपकी भाया जानकी जी को उसी तरह नहीं पचा सकता, जिस प्रकार विष को कोई नहीं पचा सकता

verses.sloka: अग्निष्टोमादिभिः यज्ञैः इष्टवान् आप्त दक्षिणैः ।तस्य अयम् पूर्वजः पुत्रो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः ॥४-४-८॥
verses.transliteration: agniṣṭomādibhiḥ yajñaiḥ iṣṭavān āpta dakṣiṇaiḥ ।tasya ayam pūrvajaḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ ॥4-4-8॥

translations.english: 'Here is his eldest son, popularly known as Rama. He is the protector of all beings and never failed his father's instructions.
translations.hindi: हे महाबाहो ! आप शोक छोड़ दीजिए । में आपकी प्यारी को लाए देता हूँ | हे राम ! में अनुमान से जानता हूँ कि निस्सन्देह बही सीता होगी

verses.sloka: शरण्यः सर्व भूतानाम् पितुः निर्देश पारगः ।ज्येष्टो दशरथस्य अयम् पुत्राणाम् गुणवत्तरः ॥४-४-९॥
verses.transliteration: śaraṇyaḥ sarva bhūtānām pituḥ nirdeśa pāragaḥ ।jyeṣṭo daśarathasya ayam putrāṇām guṇavattaraḥ ॥4-4-9॥

translations.english: This warrior, the most virtuous among Dasaratha's sons, endowed with royal marks and royal fortune, has been driven from the kingdom and has come here with me to dwell in the forest.

verses.sloka: राज लक्षण संयुक्तः संयुक्तो राज्य सम्पदा।राजात् भ्रष्टो मया वस्तुम् वने सार्धम् इह आगतः ॥४-४-१०॥
verses.transliteration: rāja lakṣaṇa saṁyuktaḥ saṁyukto rājya sampadā।rājāt bhraṣṭo mayā vastum vane sārdham iha āgataḥ ॥4-4-10॥

translations.english: This warrior, the most virtuous among Dasaratha's sons, endowed with royal marks and royal fortune, has been driven from the kingdom and has come here with me to dwell in the forest.
translations.hindi: झौर राबण की गोद में नागिन की तरह छटपटा रही थी उस समय भुझ समेत पाँच वानर को पबत पर बेठा देख

verses.sloka: भार्यया च महाभाग सीतया अनुगतो वशी ।दिन क्षये महातेजाः प्रभ एव दिवाकरः ॥४-४-११॥
verses.transliteration: bhāryayā ca mahābhāga sītayā anugato vaśī ।dina kṣaye mahātejāḥ prabha eva divākaraḥ ॥4-4-11॥

translations.english: 'This glorious Rama was followed by his wife, Sita, like the rays of the effulgent Sun follow him to the end of the day.

verses.sloka: अहम् अस्य अवरः भ्राता गुणैः दास्यम् उपागतः ।कृतज्ञस्य बहुज्ञस्य लक्ष्मणो नाम नामतः ॥४-४-१२॥
verses.transliteration: aham asya avaraḥ bhrātā guṇaiḥ dāsyam upāgataḥ ।kṛtajñasya bahujñasya lakṣmaṇo nāma nāmataḥ ॥4-4-12॥

translations.english: 'I am his younger brother, called Lakshmana. I have accepted the service of this learned, virtuous and grateful man.
translations.hindi: में उन्हे लाता हूँ । आप उन्हें पहचातिए | यह सुन श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने प्रियभापो सुग्रीव से कहा

verses.sloka: सुखार्हस्य महार्हस्य सर्वभूत हितात्मनः ।ऐश्वर्येण विहीनस्य वनवासे रतस्य च ॥४-४-१३॥
verses.transliteration: sukhārhasya mahārhasya sarvabhūta hitātmanaḥ ।aiśvaryeṇa vihīnasya vanavāse ratasya ca ॥4-4-13॥

translations.english: 'This man who should have lived in comfort and in reverence, one who was worthy of all the wellwishers lost his wealth and was banished into the forest. He is now deprived of his wife kidnapped by an unknown demon who could assume any form at will.
translations.hindi: हे मित्र | उन सत्र वस्तुओं को शोत ले आओ । विलंब क्यों कर रहे हो ! जब श्रीरामचन्द्र ने यह्‌ कहा, तब सुग्रीव ने श्रीराम- चन्द्र जी को प्रसन्न करने के लिए पहाड़ की एक गहन गुफा में प्रवेश किया और शीघ्रता पूर्वक उस उत्तरीय वस्त्र और उन बह. सूल्यवान्‌ आभूषण को ला कर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के सामने रखा और यह कहा कि, ये देखिए वे ही हैं | तब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी उन बस्त्रों और उन बढ़िया गहनों को हाथ में लेकर

verses.sloka: रक्षस अपहृता भार्या रहिते काम रूपिणा ।तत् च न ज्ञायते रक्षः पत्नी येन अस्य वा हृता ॥४-४-१४॥
verses.transliteration: rakṣasa apahṛtā bhāryā rahite kāma rūpiṇā ।tat ca na jñāyate rakṣaḥ patnī yena asya vā hṛtā ॥4-4-14॥

translations.english: 'This man who should have lived in comfort and in reverence, one who was worthy of all the wellwishers lost his wealth and was banished into the forest. He is now deprived of his wife kidnapped by an unknown demon who could assume any form at will.
translations.hindi: प्रतिवेश तत! शीघं राघरम्रियकाम्य था | उत्तरीयं गृहात्वा तु शुभान्यामरण्यानि च

verses.sloka: दनुः नाम दितेः पुत्रः शापात् राक्षसताम् गतः ।आख्यातः तेन सुग्रीवः समर्थो वानराधिपः ॥४-४-१५॥
verses.transliteration: danuḥ nāma diteḥ putraḥ śāpāt rākṣasatām gataḥ ।ākhyātaḥ tena sugrīvaḥ samartho vānarādhipaḥ ॥4-4-15॥

translations.english: 'Diti's son called Danu who had been cursed to live the life of a demon had said that Sugriva, the best among monkeys, would be able to locate her.

verses.sloka: स ज्ञास्यति महावीर्यः तव भार्या अपहारिणम् ।एवम् उक्त्वा दनुः स्वर्गम् भ्राजमानो दिवम् गतः ॥४-४-१६॥
verses.transliteration: sa jñāsyati mahāvīryaḥ tava bhāryā apahāriṇam ।evam uktvā danuḥ svargam bhrājamāno divam gataḥ ॥4-4-16॥

translations.english: 'That Valiant Sugriva can spot the demon who has abducted your wife', said Danu and disappeared happily into heaven shining in brilliance.
translations.hindi: तरीय वञ्ज सहित कई एक उत्तम आभूषणों को ऊपर से जोड़ा । उत सब को मैंने उठा कर रख छोड़ा है

verses.sloka: एतत् ते सर्वम् आख्यातम् याथातथ्येन पृच्छतः ।अहम् चैव च रामः च सुग्रीवम् शरणम् गतौ ॥४-४-१७॥
verses.transliteration: etat te sarvam ākhyātam yāthātathyena pṛcchataḥ ।aham caiva ca rāmaḥ ca sugrīvam śaraṇam gatau ॥4-4-17॥

translations.english: 'I have given a factual account of everything, since you asked me. Now Rama and I have arrived seeking Sugriva's shelter.
translations.hindi: । वे प्यारी” कह कर रोते हुए, धीरज छोड़ भूमि पर गिर | पड़े । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी उन बढ़िया आभूषणों को बार बार छाती से —— णाणणन्णाण आए? १ परिदेवयितु --प्रलपितु ।( गो० ) लगा , बिल में बैठे क्रुद्ध सपे की तरह इसका छोड़ने लगे और नेत्रा से अविरल अश्रधार प्रवाहित कर बगल में बेठे लक्ष्मण को ओर देख दीन भाव से प्रलाप करने लगे ! बे बोले-- हे लच््मण ! देखो, जब राक्षस जानकी को हर कर लिए जाता था, तब उस ये वस्तुएँ नीचे डाली थीं

verses.sloka: एष दत्त्वा च वित्तानि प्राप्य च अनुत्तमम् यशः ।लोकनाथः पुरा भूत्वा सुग्रीवम् नाथम् इच्छति ॥४-४-१८॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa dattvā ca vittāni prāpya ca anuttamam yaśaḥ ।lokanāthaḥ purā bhūtvā sugrīvam nātham icchati ॥4-4-18॥

translations.english: 'Having earned supreme fame through his munificence in the past, this lord of the world now craves Sugriva's indulgence.

verses.sloka: सीता यस्य स्नुषा च आसीत् शरण्यो धर्मवत्सलः ।तस्य पुत्रः शरण्यस्य सुग्रीवम् शरणम् गतः ॥४-४-१९॥
verses.transliteration: sītā yasya snuṣā ca āsīt śaraṇyo dharmavatsalaḥ ।tasya putraḥ śaraṇyasya sugrīvam śaraṇam gataḥ ॥4-4-19॥

translations.english: 'One whose father was once a protector of dharma, a refuge to all now seeks Sugriva's shelter.

verses.sloka: सर्व लोकस्य धर्मात्मा शरण्यः शरणम् पुरा ।गुरुर् मे राघवः सोऽयम् सुग्रीवम् शरणम् गतः ॥४-४-२०॥
verses.transliteration: sarva lokasya dharmātmā śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇam purā ।gurur me rāghavaḥ so'yam sugrīvam śaraṇam gataḥ ॥4-4-20॥

translations.english: 'This righteous Rama who used to lend in the past protection to the whole world and, indeed, a refuge to all, venerable sir, now seeks Sugriva's shelter.
translations.hindi: ॥ सीता ने ८रण के समय यह उत्तरीय वस्त्र आर ये आभूषण अपने शरीर से उतार कर हरी घास से युक्त भूमि पर छोड़ दिए इस प्रकार कहने पर लक्ष्मण जी ने कहा

verses.sloka: यस्य प्रसादे सततम् प्रसीदेयुः इमाः प्रजाः ।स रामः वानरेन्द्रस्य प्रसादम् अभिकाङ्क्षते ॥४-४-२१॥
verses.transliteration: yasya prasāde satatam prasīdeyuḥ imāḥ prajāḥ ।sa rāmaḥ vānarendrasya prasādam abhikāṅkṣate ॥4-4-21॥

translations.english: 'This Rama for whose grace the subjects were ever bobolden to him now seeks the favour of the Chief of monkeys.

verses.sloka: येन सर्व गुणोपेताः पृथिव्याम् सर्व पार्थिवाः ।मानिताः सततम् राज्ञा सदा दशरथेन वै ॥४-४-२२॥
verses.transliteration: yena sarva guṇopetāḥ pṛthivyām sarva pārthivāḥ ।mānitāḥ satatam rājñā sadā daśarathena vai ॥4-4-22॥

translations.english: 'Famous in all the three worlds, this Rama, who was the firshborn of Dasaratha, endowed with all virtues and ever respected by all the kings of this earth, now seeks shelter of Sugriva, Chief of monkeys.
translations.hindi: सें सीता के बाजूबन्द ओर कुण्डलों को नहीं पहचानता, किन्तु हाँ. में उनके ( पैर के) बिछुओं को अवश्य पहचानता हूँ; क्योंकि चरणवंदना के समय इनको में नित्य ही देखा करता था

verses.sloka: तस्य अयम् पूर्वजः पुत्रः त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः ।सुग्रीवम् वानरेन्द्रम् तु रामः शरणम् आगतः ॥४-४-२३॥
verses.transliteration: tasya ayam pūrvajaḥ putraḥ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ ।sugrīvam vānarendram tu rāmaḥ śaraṇam āgataḥ ॥4-4-23॥

translations.english: 'Famous in all the three worlds, this Rama, who was the firshborn of Dasaratha, endowed with all virtues and ever respected by all the kings of this earth, now seeks shelter of Sugriva, Chief of monkeys.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--येह है भारत-की प्राचीन संस्कृति और उच्च आदर्श चरित्र । लक्षण इतने दिनों जानकी के साथ रहे ड्निन्तु आँख उठा कर मीता की ओर कभी न देखा । ` ततः सं राघवो दीनः सुग्रीवमिदमत्रवीत्‌ । ' ब्रुहि सुग्रीत्र क देशं हियन्ती लक्षिता त्वया

verses.sloka: शोक अभिभूते रामे तु शोक आर्ते शरणम् गते ।कर्तुम् अर्हति सुग्रीवः प्रसादम् सह यूथपैः ॥४-४-२४॥
verses.transliteration: śoka abhibhūte rāme tu śoka ārte śaraṇam gate ।kartum arhati sugrīvaḥ prasādam saha yūthapaiḥ ॥4-4-24॥

translations.english: 'Sugriva, lord of monkeys, ought to help Rama who tormented by, and overwhelmed with, grief seeks his favour.'
translations.hindi: मेरी प्यारी प्रिया का हर कर ले जाने वाला वह भयङ्कर राक्षस कहाँ रहता है, जिसने मुझे यह बड़ा भारी दु:ख दे रक्स्वा हे

verses.sloka: एवम् ब्रुवाणम् सौमित्रिम् करुणम् स अश्रु पातनम् ।हनुमान् प्रति उवाच इदम् वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः ॥४-४-२५॥
verses.transliteration: evam bruvāṇam saumitrim karuṇam sa aśru pātanam ।hanumān prati uvāca idam vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ ॥4-4-25॥

translations.english: To Saumitri who was speaking thus in a piteous tone, his eyes filled with tears the eloquent Hanuman replied:

verses.sloka: ईदृशा बुद्धि संपन्ना जितक्रोधा जितेइन्द्रियाः ।द्रष्टव्या वानरेइन्द्रेण दिष्ट्या दर्शनम् आगताः ॥४-४-२६॥
verses.transliteration: īdṛśā buddhi saṁpannā jitakrodhā jiteindriyāḥ ।draṣṭavyā vānareindreṇa diṣṭyā darśanam āgatāḥ ॥4-4-26॥

translations.english: 'It is a matter of great fortune that you who have intelligence, control over your senses and conquered anger have come to see the lord of monkeys who needs instead, to approach you.

verses.sloka: स हि राज्यात् च विभ्रष्टः कृत वैरः च वालिना ।हृत दारो वने त्रस्तः भ्रात्रा विनिकृतः भृशम् ॥४-४-२७॥
verses.transliteration: sa hi rājyāt ca vibhraṣṭaḥ kṛta vairaḥ ca vālinā ।hṛta dāro vane trastaḥ bhrātrā vinikṛtaḥ bhṛśam ॥4-4-27॥

translations.english: '(In fact) seriously offended by his brother Vali who treated him like his enemy and expelled him from the kingdom. He is now abandoned in the forest, his wife hijacked.

verses.sloka: करिष्यति स साहाय्यम् युवयोः भास्करात्मजः ।सुग्रीवः सह च अस्माभिः सीतायाः परिमार्गणे ॥४-४-२८॥
verses.transliteration: kariṣyati sa sāhāyyam yuvayoḥ bhāskarātmajaḥ ।sugrīvaḥ saha ca asmābhiḥ sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇe ॥4-4-28॥

translations.english: 'Sugriva, son of the Sungod, along with us will extend all help to you, in your search for Sita.'

verses.sloka: इति एवम् उक्त्वा हनुमान् श्लक्ष्णम् मधुरया गिरा ।बभाषे साधु गच्छामः सुग्रीवम् इति राघवम् ॥४-४-२९॥
verses.transliteration: iti evam uktvā hanumān ślakṣṇam madhurayā girā ।babhāṣe sādhu gacchāmaḥ sugrīvam iti rāghavam ॥4-4-29॥

translations.english: Hanuman, having spoken with sweet, gentle words said to the Raghavas, 'We will now go to Sugriva'.

verses.sloka: एवम् ब्रुवन्तम् धर्मात्मा हनूमन्तम् स लक्ष्मणः ।प्रतिपूज्य यथा न्यायम् इदम् प्रोवाच राघवम् ॥४-४-३०॥
verses.transliteration: evam bruvantam dharmātmā hanūmantam sa lakṣmaṇaḥ ।pratipūjya yathā nyāyam idam provāca rāghavam ॥4-4-30॥

translations.english: Having offered reverential salutations to Hanuman as per tradition, righteous Lakshmana now spoke to Rama:

verses.sloka: कपिः कथयते हृष्टो यथा अयम् मारुतात्मजः ।कृत्यवान् सोऽपि संप्राप्तः कृत कृत्योऽसि राघव ॥४-४-३१॥
verses.transliteration: kapiḥ kathayate hṛṣṭo yathā ayam mārutātmajaḥ ।kṛtyavān so'pi saṁprāptaḥ kṛta kṛtyo'si rāghava ॥4-4-31॥

translations.english: 'O Raghava this monkey, son of the Windgod appears pleased as evident from his words. As he is a man of action, take your work as accomplished now.

verses.sloka: प्रसन्न मुख वर्णः च व्यक्तम् हृष्टः च भाषते ।न अनृतम् वक्ष्यते वीरो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः ॥४-४-३२॥
verses.transliteration: prasanna mukha varṇaḥ ca vyaktam hṛṣṭaḥ ca bhāṣate ।na anṛtam vakṣyate vīro hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ ॥4-4-32॥

translations.english: 'It is evident from his words and from his cheerful face that Hanuman is pleased. (I know that) this heroic son of the Windgod will never tell a lie'.

verses.sloka: ततः स सुमहाप्राज्ञः हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।जगाम आदाय तौ वीरौ हरि राजाय राघवौ ॥४-४-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa sumahāprājñaḥ hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।jagāma ādāya tau vīrau hari rājāya rāghavau ॥4-4-33॥

translations.english: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, endowed with great wisdom carried both the Raghava warriors to the king of monkeys.

verses.sloka: भिक्षु रूपम् परित्यज्य वानरम् रूपम् आस्थितः ।पृष्टम् आरोप्य तौ वीरौ जगाम कपिकुङ्जरः ॥४-४-३४॥
verses.transliteration: bhikṣu rūpam parityajya vānaram rūpam āsthitaḥ ।pṛṣṭam āropya tau vīrau jagāma kapikuṅjaraḥ ॥4-4-34॥

translations.english: Hanuman, who was an elephant among monkeys, gave up the guise of a mendicant, and assuming the form of the monkeys, lifted both the heroes on to his back and proceeded.

verses.sloka: स तु विपुल यशाः कपि प्रवीरः पवनसुतः कृत कृत्यवत् प्रहृष्टः ।गिरि वरम् उरुविक्रमः प्रयातः स शुभमतिः सह राम लक्ष्मणाभ्याम् ॥४-४-३५॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu vipula yaśāḥ kapi pravīraḥ pavanasutaḥ kṛta kṛtyavat prahṛṣṭaḥ ।giri varam uruvikramaḥ prayātaḥ sa śubhamatiḥ saha rāma lakṣmaṇābhyām ॥4-4-35॥

translations.english: The son of the Windgod, the most valiant, the supremely heroic monkey and the one welladmired, having performed his task, felt immensely happy.And with an auspicious feeling, departed for the great mountain (Rishyamuka) along with Rama and Lakshmana. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किंधाकाण्डे चतुर्थस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fourth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
